epics.title: Initial Content and Acceptance
epics.jtbd: When receiving the delivered system, I want to see it populated with realistic content, so that I can verify all paths and features work end-to-end.
requirements: R1: The instance holds realistic initial content sufficient to exercise every link of every declared path.
R2: One complete traversal of each live path has been performed on the instance.

slices.title: Verification of initial content and live paths
slices.jtbd: When implementing verification of initial content and live paths for this epic, I want to execute comprehensive end-to-end tests against realistic data, so that I can verify all paths and features work end-to-end.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed instance populated with initial realistic content
When a complete traversal of each live path is executed
Then the instance behaves correctly without errors
Given the verification process
When the traversal is completed
Then the results are recorded and confirm that the instance operates correctly with the initial content
